entries.6839bb702f7b209d: It has a mass customization production and supply system that responds to specifications differing by customer through made-to-order production and just-in-time supply, and in 1986 it introduced MRP (material requirements planning) ahead of the industry to shift toward high-mix, low-volume production. entries.80e47908e48606bf: It has as its management philosophy “We provide interior system components to create comfortable living spaces.” Drawing on its capability for mass customization through made-to-order production and just-in-time supply, and on its sales engineering capability, in which sales, design, manufacturing and construction management are integrated, it will advance new product development, new customer development and expansion of its sales areas. In Japan, in addition to expanding its share in condominiums and detached houses, it will extend into non-residential fields such as hotels and medical and nursing care facilities, and into the renovation field for multi-family housing; in China, it will shift to a sales strategy that emphasizes credit risk, expand sales to non-residential fields, and develop overseas markets such as Taiwan.
